AffirmationStatus.name: Affirmation Status
AffirmationStatus.definition: Status of affirmation of a trade.

AllocationStatus.name: Allocation Status
AllocationStatus.definition: Provides the status of allocation of collateral to cover the instruction.

RepoCallRequestStatus.name: Repo Call Request Status
RepoCallRequestStatus.definition: Provides the status of the repurchase agreement call request.

CorporateActionEventProcessingStatus.name: Corporate Action Event Processing Status
CorporateActionEventProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the status of a corporate action or the status of a payment.

CorporateActionEventStage.name: Corporate Action Event Stage
CorporateActionEventStage.definition: Stage in the corporate action event life cycle.

InferredMatchingStatus.name: Inferred Matching Status
InferredMatchingStatus.definition: Provides the matching status of an instruction as known by the account servicer based on an allegement. At this time no matching took place on the market (at the CSD/ICSD).

InstructionProcessingStatus.name: Instruction Processing Status
InstructionProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the status of an instruction.

MatchingStatus.name: Matching Status
MatchingStatus.definition: Provides the matching status of the instruction.

RegistrationProcessingStatus.name: Registration Processing Status
RegistrationProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the status of the registration processing.

ResponseStatus.name: Response Status
ResponseStatus.definition: Provides the status of the received collateral message (collateral claim, a collateral proposal or a proposal/request for collateral substitution) from a collateral management perspective.

ReplacementProcessingStatus.name: Replacement Processing Status
ReplacementProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the processing status of the replacement request.

CancellationProcessingStatus.name: Cancellation Processing Status
CancellationProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the status of a cancellation request.

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Provides the status of settlement of a transaction.

SettlementConditionModificationStatus.name: Settlement Condition Modification Status
SettlementConditionModificationStatus.definition: Provides the status of a securities settlement condition modification request.

StatusRule.definition: If a specific Status is requested, then it must be in line with the statuses available for the message type requested.
